Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 47

“Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus on the field of battle, Arjuna sank down on the seat of his chariot, casting away his bow and arrows, his mind distressed with grief.”

Chapter 1 ends not in resolution but in collapse. Arjuna puts down his weapons and sits, and this is the low point that everything Krishna says from here onward is answering.
